The '''Paecia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained [[Paecia/Legends|Paecia]], a world inhabited by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who founded the famed [[Paecian Empire]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era.<ref name="TCSWE" />
